items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Collins was the manager of Louie and Collins pulled Louie out from the band in New York... Collins had the band then. Connie's Inn

ctx.x: Well, didn't they play at the Regal before then?

This band -- this band to my knowing never got to the Regal. No, this band never got to the Regal because Collins was the manager of Louie and Collins pulled Louie out from the band in New York and sent us back home and sent Louie over in France.
Well, that was a little later. There's a famous incident, in fact, it was a part of that television show on Louie, at the Showboat --
